name: SISO Shell
summary: The shared CRM-derived navigation, reusable page parts and static template bank for SISO reading surfaces. Consumers pin an exact source revision and supply reviewed project data; a template example is not a current project observation.

evidence.summary: Current public grouped-rail source reviewed and installed in the Library consumer. CRM token bytes and bundled attribution are retained.
The public bank and U4 example were opened. Example data is dated demonstration content, not live owner or deployment truth.

license.reason: Initial shell publication explicitly grants no general redistribution license.

evidence.summary: The original static implementation and its current licensing boundary are documented.

relationships.context: The Library renders the shared shell and copies its pinned assets as generated output; the shell retains independent source ownership.

evidence.summary: The root and Foundry pilot import the published shell package at the exact commit pin.
Public GitHub commit resolved at the exact source pin.

The Library imports the exact package commit at build time. Root and Foundry pages passed desktop click/keyboard/reload checks, 20px collapsed width and mobile overflow checks; both were captured at 2000x1250. Shell escaping and unsafe-link tests passed.
Current public grouped-rail source reviewed and installed in the Library consumer. CRM token bytes and bundled attribution are retained.

reading.subtitle: One shared design source, composed into the reading page each project actually needs.
reading.why: The bank separates navigation, reusable parts and page-family compositions. A consumer selects a reviewed source revision and supplies its own public-safe data. Updates become deliberate upgrades: review the source, register its evidence, select it in a Snapshot, re-pin the consumer, and verify the rendered result. Template presence and an old example do not establish deployment, project ownership or acceptance.

highlights.title: Reuse the shared shell
highlights.summary: Read the grouped navigation API and exact build-time reuse contract before wiring a consumer. Keep the shell in its owning repository.

highlights.title: Choose a page family
highlights.summary: Browse the existing template catalogue to choose a composition, then replace demonstration data with reviewed source-owned inputs.

highlights.title: Trace the component provenance
highlights.summary: Distinguish installed design-hub sources from preview-derived patterns, and retain notices when reusing the package.
